Name: Razolyn the Magnificent - Non Skimpy Version
Author: MissCoriel
Description:
[center]﻿[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/mCRzEQq.png[/img]﻿
[/size]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Razolyn the Magnificent is [u]THE[/u] Wizard Replacement Mod you are looking for!  Thanks to the efforts of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/26612284]ParadigmNomad[/url], Razolyn has 7 different expressive portraits (normal, happy, sad, angry, blushing, ditsy, and arrogant) versus the wizard's 2 (normal and happy).  Each event has extended dialogue to give Razolyn her own unique personality. She's wonderful to look at and has double the dialogue as you befriend her. This is a non-adult version of the mod.
If you are looking for that Go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2898]the NORMAL Version[/url]﻿.

[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/QpHx68J.png[/img]﻿
[/size]

1. Ensure you have the latest and correct [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (2.7 or Better)
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 1.4 or Better
3. Download this mod and Unzip into your MODS folder (should say [CP]RazolynStandalone)
4. Enjoy!

﻿

[/font][/center]
